change: FluidSequenceEngine records checkpoint id, node id, zero-based local tick index, scheduler elapsed ticks and monotonic elapsed nanoseconds when a checkpoint condition is satisfied. Records are emitted through existing workflow measurements and reset with each sequence.
authority: Observation only. No successor admission, execution extension, permission or terminal authority is granted.

assertions: No checkpoint settlement before the checkpoint executes.
One settlement identifies the exact checkpoint and node.
Settlement reports tick index 3 and scheduler elapsed ticks 4 for the fixture.
Elapsed monotonic time is nonnegative and returned settlement list is immutable.

remaining: Exact checkpoint revision and evidence linkage
